overview_description.description:
Dhad is an audio publishing house that produces and publishes books.

The publishing house provides a wide range of fiction and non-fiction titles that can be accessed on any device, anywhere, for easy listening. Its content is also accessible through its website and smartphone app.

Manar Saud Alomayri founded the Riyadh, Ar Riyad-based company in 2015.
